'''Cith Sninif''' was a [[Ug'Ggeran]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who was seriously injured while trying to stop the [[Thief/Legends|theft]] of [[Meleenium/Legends|Meleenium]] from the [[Qua'Tahc]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] on [[Af'El/Legends|Af'El]].<ref name="SWAJ10:WBC">{{JournalCite|10|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref>
